definitions.attribution: (q_new-q_old)*net_per_lot_old + q_new*(net_per_lot_new-net_per_lot_old); new/lost entries separate; arithmetic, no reallocation counterfactual
definitions.diagnostic_scope: recorded market-qualified or confirmed observations only; no_listed_block is not an accepted order or fill; observed capacities precede same-minute priority allocations; actual_trigger_counts uses the final signal ledger
definitions.formed_scales: signal-time audited journal arithmetic for every formed timestamp; no future extrema; training target and scaled target are mechanical references, not favorable-space forecasts
definitions.R: net / integer-lots initial-price-stop-risk; budget R includes modeled cost buffer; summing R does not create a continuous capital curve

initialization_recovery.error: 诊断准备后训练数据已改变，拒绝沿用旧执行资格和跳数
initialization_recovery.reason: batch prepared control config once; scope_data constructed a plain Dataset for the next variant and lost PreparedDataset full-training proof. Raw source and verified training hashes are preserved.
initialization_recovery.recovery: Prepare September independently with each frozen variant config through the existing standalone run path; retain all source and plan hashes for the 24 evaluations.
initialization_recovery.attempt_accounting: The failed initializer is preserved under failed_initialization_ at the same depth, with identical bytes and relative data references. It is excluded from completed run_* evaluations and explicitly included as one extra operational attempt. This is a disclosed initialization-recovery exception to maximum_runs=24; no new strategy configuration, retuning or erased result.

post_replay_runner_repair.repair: September batch delegates numeric preparation to the existing standalone run path per exact variant config; July and August retain shared numeric preparation. Original full-training validation remains enabled.
post_replay_runner_repair.replay_existing_frozen_plan: Use its archived source to repeat evaluation; current layers still rejects source changes against that original freeze. Reassess existing audited ledgers with research.structure_assessment.
